user.title: Allegro
user.description: Sign in with Browser Companion (Chromium in the sidebar), or paste QXLSESSID.

cookie.title: Allegro
cookie.description: Go to {allegro_url} and get the QXLSESSID cookie using browser dev tools (F12).

companion.title: Browser Companion
companion.description:
Open Browser Companion in a new window:

[{companion_url}]({companion_href})

Sign in on allegro.pl, then go to {orders_url}. QXLSESSID is captured on that page.

companion_failed.title: Browser Companion
companion_failed.description:
Could not sign in with Browser Companion. Start the add-on, then submit to try again. You can also cancel and paste QXLSESSID instead.

[{companion_url}]({companion_href})

abort.companion_unavailable: Browser Companion did not capture the login. Try again or paste QXLSESSID.

progress.companion_wait:
Open Browser Companion in a new window:

[{companion_url}]({companion_href})

Sign in, then open {orders_url}. This screen updates when QXLSESSID is captured.

data.auto_read_messages: Mark automatic order messages as read

data_description.default_pickup_point: Code of your usual parcel locker, for example WAW01A. Used to flag parcels waiting in a different pickup point.
data_description.auto_read_messages: Marks automatic shop messages (order received, being packed, and similar) as read once the seller has no order on its way or the message is old enough. Invoices and personal messages are never touched.
data_description.auto_read_days: Age of an automatic message after which it is marked as read even if an order is still on its way.

add_to_cart_failed.message: Could not add offer {item_id} to the cart: {error}

multiple_accounts.message: Multiple Allegro accounts are configured. Select an account.

mark_read_failed.message: Could not mark the message as read: {error}

download_failed.message: Could not download the attachment of message {thread_id}: {error}

no_attachment.message: This message has no attachment to download.

directory_not_allowed.message: Directory {directory} is not allowed. Add it to allowlist_external_dirs or use a directory inside the Home Assistant configuration.

add_to_cart.name: Add to cart
add_to_cart.description: Add an Allegro offer to the shopping cart.

item_id.name: Offer ID
item_id.description: Allegro offerId from the offer URL query parameter, for example 15070058532.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Allegro account to use when more than one is configured.

mark_message_read.name: Mark message as read
mark_message_read.description: Open a message thread so that Allegro marks it as read.

thread_id.name: Thread ID
thread_id.description: Message thread ID, shown as thread_id in the sensor attributes.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Allegro account to use when more than one is configured.

mark_messages_read.name: Mark messages as read
mark_messages_read.description: Mark all unread message threads of one category as read (up to 50 at a time).

category.name: Category
category.description: order_status: automatic shop messages, invoice: messages with an invoice, other: everything else.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Allegro account to use when more than one is configured.

download_invoice.name: Download invoice
download_invoice.description: Download the attachments of a message thread, for example an invoice PDF, into a directory. Opening the thread marks it as read.

thread_id.name: Thread ID
thread_id.description: Message thread ID, shown as thread_id in the invoice sensor attributes.

directory.name: Directory
directory.description: Where to save the files. Defaults to allegro_invoices in the Home Assistant configuration directory.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Allegro account to use when more than one is configured.
